summary: An empty or reasoning-only final answer after successful tool calls now ends the turn normally. Protocol layer: Chat (stream finish + JSON; null content accepted when a message object exists), Responses (stream + JSON; extract_responses_content no longer rejects text-less output) and Anthropic (message_stop) no longer return EmptyResponse once a terminal/completion event was seen; missing completion events stay InvalidResponse. Core: the post-completion EmptyResponse check moved into complete_with_tools and only fires when no tool ran this turn (tool_iterations == 0); otherwise an assistant turn with empty content is persisted. Replay: empty assistant turns without tool calls are omitted on Responses/Chat, and Anthropic omits assistant messages with no non-empty text and no tool_use (empty/thinking-only), so the next turn encodes valid history. Gemini unchanged (already accepts thought/empty parts and replays native parts).
